title: betterlite review
description: A reviewer's final answer about one task branch. Every finding cites a rule from .development/rules.yaml.

task.description: The task id, for example B004.

verdict.description: changes when at least one finding has origin ours, approve otherwise.

location.description: path:line of the code the finding is about, path relative to the repository root.

origin.description: ours when betterlite introduced the problem; litellm when the code repeats LiteLLM's own behavior and rule owned-behavior-is-built says to fix that bug. Only ours findings go back to the worker; litellm findings go to the architect.

problem.description: What breaks the rule, in one or two sentences.

rule.description: A rule id from .development/rules.yaml whose reviewed flag is true.
